model.name: Minimax H3
model.shortDescription: MiniMax H3 generates video from text, first/last frames, or multimodal references. Native stereo audio; 5-15s clips up to 2K at 24fps.

inputs.description: An image to use as the video's opening frame. The video's shape follows this image. Can't be combined with reference images, videos, or audio.
inputs.label: First Frame
inputs.name: firstFrameImage

lastFrameImage.message: A first frame must be provided if a last frame is set.

inputs.description: An image to use as the video's closing frame. Only works when a first frame is also set. Can't be combined with reference images, videos, or audio.
inputs.label: Last Frame
inputs.name: lastFrameImage

inputs.description: Images to guide the subjects or style (up to 9, max 30 MB each). Can't be combined with a first or last frame. First 5 are free; additional images are billed.
inputs.label: Reference Images
inputs.name: referenceImages

inputs.description: Videos to guide the motion (up to 3, each 2–15s and 2–15s in total, max 50 MB each). Can't be combined with a first or last frame. Billed per second of uploaded duration.
inputs.label: Reference Videos
inputs.name: referenceVideos

inputs.description: Audio to guide the video (up to 3, each 2–15s and 2–15s in total, max 15 MB each). Requires at least one reference image or video.
inputs.label: Reference Audio
inputs.name: referenceAudio

inputs.description: How long the video lasts, in seconds (5-15). Longer videos cost more.
inputs.label: Duration
inputs.name: duration

inputs.description: The output quality. Higher resolutions cost more.
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.name: resolution

inputs.description: The shape of the video. Auto picks a fitting shape. Ignored when a first frame is set, since the shape follows that image.
inputs.label: Aspect Ratio
inputs.name: aspectRatio
